title: PhD Thesis Defense Successfully Held in the Department of Political Science at AWKUM
text:
Academic Achievement

PhD Thesis Defense Successfully Held at AWKUM

Department of Political Science · Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

A PhD thesis defense was successfully held in the
Department of Political Science, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)
, marking an important academic milestone for the researcher and the department.

PhD Thesis Title

“Post-Conflict Peace-Building Initiatives in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: A Comparative Analysis of ANP and PTI Provincial Governments from 2008–2022”

PhD Scholar

Ms. Sumayya Feroz

Supervisor

Dr. Manzoor Ahmad

External Experts

Dr. Zahid Anwar
Dr. Manzoor Afridi

During the defense,
Ms. Sumayya Feroz
presented the findings of her research and engaged in an academic discussion with the panel. The study comparatively examined the
peace-building initiatives undertaken by the ANP and PTI provincial governments in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa from 2008 to 2022
, with particular emphasis on post-conflict peace-building, governance, and related policy initiatives.

The defense provided an opportunity for the researcher to critically present and discuss the methodology, findings, and conclusions of the study before the academic panel. The research contributes to the broader field of
Political Science
, particularly to the understanding of post-conflict peace-building and governance in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

The successful completion of the PhD thesis defense is a significant academic achievement for
Ms. Sumayya Feroz
and reflects the scholarly efforts of the researcher under the supervision of
Dr. Manzoor Ahmad
. It also highlights the Department of Political Science's continued contribution to advanced research and academic excellence at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.
